discord.lead: Recreates a server's categories, channels and custom emoji as a Pollis group, in the same order. Messages stay on Discord, and people join through an invite link.
discord.howTo: Export the server with DiscordChatExporter on this computer: JSON format, with media. Add discord-guild.json beside it for roles, private channels and exact order. Pollis never needs your Discord login.
discord.nothingToDo: Everything in this export is already in the group. Importing again changes nothing.
discord.targetExistingDetail: Adds only what's missing; nothing is changed or removed.
discord.privateOnDiscord: Private on Discord. Every group member will see it.
discord.noteAnnouncement: Announcement channel, imported as a text channel
discord.noteForum: Forum, imported as a text channel
discord.noteStage: Stage, imported as a voice channel
discord.overwritesNote: Every member of a Pollis group sees every channel, so Discord's per-channel permissions, listed under each channel, are not kept.
discord.skipOrphanThread: A thread whose channel isn't in the export
discord.emojiRenamed: {{taken}} was taken, so it gets a new name
discord.emojiNoShortcode: No usable name (2 to 32 of a–z, 0–9 and _)
discord.emojiImageRemote: Only a Discord link; export again with media
discord.emojiImageMissing: Its picture isn't in the export
discord.rolesLead: Pollis groups have members and admins.
discord.rolesUnknown: Roles carry no permissions without discord-guild.json, so nobody is marked as an admin.
discord.peopleLead: Discord shares no email addresses, so nobody is invited automatically. Share the group's invite link with these people, then make the marked ones admins once they join.
discord.noteNoEmails: Discord shares no email addresses: people join through the invite link.
discord.noteNoSnapshot: Without discord-guild.json, channel order follows creation date and empty categories are left out.
discord.notePrivate_one: {{count}} channel was private on Discord. Every member of a Pollis group can see every channel.
discord.notePrivate_other: {{count}} channels were private on Discord. Every member of a Pollis group can see every channel.
discord.noteRoles_one: {{count}} role has no Pollis equivalent and is dropped.
discord.noteRoles_other: {{count}} roles have no Pollis equivalent and are dropped.
discord.noteHistory_one: Messages aren't imported: {{count}} message stays on Discord.
discord.noteHistory_other: Messages aren't imported: {{count}} messages stay on Discord.
discord.doneExisting_one: {{count}} item was already there and was left alone.
discord.doneExisting_other: {{count}} items were already there and were left alone.
discord.doneFailures: Some items didn't import. Import again to retry them:
discord.linkExisting: The group already has an invite link. Make a new one from the group's invite page if you need it.
